purpose: Normal-body references reduce only answer-map HTML transport while every canonical normal/free/all-answer body, shape, scope and print snapshot is restored unchanged.

baseline.description: Current JSON implementation before normal-body references
baseline.explicitBaselineLoader: Pre-codec JSON loader selected with bootstrap-loader=legacy and a target-only legacy-bootstrap override; legacy is a source-selection label, not the old object-literal format.

payload.scope: Actual native template output for the same frozen query. Browser proxy/transport markers add small byte differences recorded per request. This is implemented output size, distinct from the prior47.94MB byte-only estimate.

postOperationMemoryTradeoff.initialReady: Main3sample isolated comparisons retain about22.65MB less JS heap and19.7to21.5MB less private commit after GC. Parent/cache comparisons also improve at this checkpoint; values are not persistent-session guarantees.
postOperationMemoryTradeoff.hashEnabled: After full operations plus diagnostic all-body JSON/UTF8 hashing, PC JS heap is90.54to91.52MB and mobile90.58to91.44MB; the initial22MB difference no longer persists. This run intentionally serializes every body and is not the usual mobile UI workload.
postOperationMemoryTradeoff.hashDisabledPc: The ordinary PC workflow still includes a full canonical print-capacity probe and bounded print. After GC JS heap is90,535,808to91,714,996bytes and private commit456,384,512to454,389,760bytes, approximately comparable in these single observations.
postOperationMemoryTradeoff.hashDisabledMobile: The ordinary mobile workflow has no print UI and no diagnostic full-text hash. JS heap is90,538,512to68,086,028bytes and private commit435,425,280to410,169,344bytes after operations; the difference is retained in this one observation.
postOperationMemoryTradeoff.scope: These are single workload-specific observations, not before/after speed tests or statistically stable retained-memory guarantees. They do not isolate or prove V8 string flattening, GC or a particular internal cause. Large future stringification/print operations may change retention; initial and post-operation checkpoints remain separate.

interpretation: Actual native HTML falls from72,597,521to47,621,581UTF8bytes, saving24,975,940bytes/34.4033% for this dataset. Full canonical data and all answers remain after decode.

Live loading-cleared medians are PC2921.6to2635.5ms and mobile emulation4888.0to4175.1ms. Combined-ready and frozen-data results are separately recorded, not whole-app or real PostgreSQL/phone timings.

Native handler medians are1792.9to1799.6ms, so these3samples do not demonstrate a native-handler speed gain. Render/JSON encoding shrink, while SQLx and residual observations vary and overlap; independent medians must not be added.

Initial after-GC JS heap/private commit are lower in isolated and parent/cache models. The existing JSON source DOM is already removed in both variants; zero raw DOM text is not a new codec-specific memory gain.

Initial memory gains do not persist uniformly through every workload. All-text diagnostic hash runs and ordinary PC print-capacity work have near-baseline post-operation retained memory; ordinary mobile/no-print/no-hash remains lower in one observation.

Adoption evidence is reduced actual transport size, improved measured initial loading, successful exact canonical/browser-text checks and workload-bounded memory observations. No permanent-session RAM saving or universal speedup is claimed.

protocol.shape: Exact own metadata keys version/markers/shapes; kind-specific arrays contain unique nonempty string IDs, maximum128UTF-16units, without colons.
protocol.omittedFields: Only listed marker.detail or shape.geojson.properties.memo fields are omitted. Unlisted, missing, nonstring, short or nonmatching bodies remain unchanged.
protocol.producer: Require UUID-shaped IDs, string bodies/leaves and boolean sync_required; verify entire normal body equals free_text followed by managed_markdown. No Unicode normalization, trimming, added newline or parts/boundary inference.
protocol.sizeGuard: Count the exact production HTML-safe JSON string token bytes. Charge full sidecar/whitespace plus ID/comma overhead to every reference as a conservative upper bound; encode only strictly smaller values.
protocol.ownership: The dedicated transport Context moves owned JSON values. Complete read models and stored DB data remain canonical; no body fetch is deferred.
protocol.decoder: Own marker key/id must agree; shape own string IDs must be unambiguous across the whole array. Referenced geometry/properties and same-kind/id popup entries must be own records. free_text and managed_markdown must be own strings; sync_required must be an own boolean. Reject unknown versions/keys, duplicate IDs, absent/invalid refs and an already-present memo/detail, including null.
protocol.publication: Validate all references before changing values. Restore exact free+managed strings, remove only root sidecar, then perform existing bootstrap validation/cache/DOM removal. User properties with the same name are retained. Metadata on legacy global input is rejected; full JSON/global inputs without metadata remain supported.
protocol.print: Sender/receiver reject encoded sidecars. Full canonical snapshots are reconstructed before the retained32MiB capacity check; encoded bytes never bypass it.

conditions.baseline: Previously adopted full JSON bootstrap after popup SQL projection, with a frozen pre-codec JSON loader explicitly selected via bootstrap-loader=legacy and legacy-bootstrap override.
conditions.candidate: Version1 root normalBodyReferences with same-target fixed free_text+managed_markdown restoration before existing bootstrap consumers. No ordinary Vue product change.
conditions.backendScope: All real-data native/live runs use the SQLite readonly immutable copy. PostgreSQL serialization/behavior is regression tested, not a real PostgreSQL performance measurement.
conditions.frozenSpeed: Before and after use their respective acquired full/encoded HTML for the exact same canonical snapshot/query. Initial map SQL/HTML generation is excluded; actual options endpoint remains. Chrome is reused within stage, with fresh context/page per trial.
conditions.liveSpeed: Actual native form/iframe navigation through old/new real handlers and diagnostic proxy; same manifest/query and full data. Sampling, Windows memory probes and per-trial Chrome restart are disabled.
conditions.memory: Separate memory-only runs enable100ms CDP plus fixed boundary samples, precise-memory-info, Windows process checkpoints and fresh Chrome per trial. Isolated memory uses frozen HTML; coexist memory uses live handlers.
conditions.coexistence: Actual PC/mobile MapIframe, Pinia raw-record caches and normal editor are seeded with the selected19776canonical shape records, focused without popup/body GET, and retained after answer close. Setup is excluded from opening timing and render idle is verified.
conditions.coexistenceScope: This is a selected-record parent/cache model, not the entire MapView/application/authentication or every account record. Its inherited zoom16 view differs from isolated full-extent trials; compare before/after only within the same model.
conditions.fullOperations: Before/after correctness runs each PC/mobile once. Hash-enabled functional stages verify all19776decoded bodies after operations. Additional operations-memory stages omit only that all-text diagnostic hash; both sets are single observations and are separate from speed trials.
conditions.externalResources: External tiles/icons/images are local placeholders; real external latency and real authentication are excluded.
conditions.caches: Backend/OS caches are not reset. Fresh Chrome means a new browser process, not cold DB/storage/OS. Responses are no-store and contexts are isolated.
conditions.concurrency: Timed speed stages ran sequentially without builds/tests. Functional and diagnostic hash runs are not comparative timing evidence.

metricDefinitions.loadingCleared: Vue loading ref changes after answer-map-ready; does not wait for renderer idle or prove GPU paint.
metricDefinitions.loadingPaintOpportunity: Double requestAnimationFrame after loading clears; scheduling opportunity rather than proof every pixel is painted.
metricDefinitions.combinedReady: Parent scope/options/color-fieldset readiness, shape-renderer idle and frame settling, including automation coordination.
metricDefinitions.serverHandler: Server-Timing handler duration, excluding transfer/proxy work; null for frozen HTML.
metricDefinitions.bootstrapSeparateScripts: Both compared inputs in this step are application/json. Fixed marks surround inert text and include HTML parser/transfer waiting, while later JSON.parse and body restoration have separate overlapping loader spans. They are not exclusive CPU intervals.
metricDefinitions.bootstrapJsonParse: Synchronous JSON.parse call only. Loader additionally covers validation/cache/removal; these spans overlap.
metricDefinitions.proxy: Live HTML is buffered/decoded/rewritten/encoded. bootstrapTransformMs is within htmlRewriteMs; socket-send callback is not browser responseEnd.
metricDefinitions.jsHeap: Target/renderer JavaScript heap at the stated GC checkpoint; excludes important DOM/native allocations and is not total application memory. Natural GC may occur.
metricDefinitions.observedMaximum: CDP sampling and fixed performance.memory boundary maxima may miss internal transient peaks and include automation/natural GC; not true instantaneous or full native peaks.
metricDefinitions.privateCommitBytes: Sum of Windows PrivateMemorySize64 for this Chrome instance's validated CDP-listed PIDs: private committed allocation, resident or paged, rather than current physical RAM.
metricDefinitions.sumWorkingSetBytes: Sum of WorkingSet64 resident pages, including shared pages counted in multiple processes; not unique Chrome RSS or unique physical memory.
metricDefinitions.processScope: Only validated PIDs belonging to the launched Chrome instance are queried. In coexistence mode its actual parent editor iframe and Pinia caches are included. Node proxy, Rust, other apps/Chrome instances and the unmounted surrounding full MapView/auth remain outside the sum. No PID/CommandLine is exported.
metricDefinitions.domTextRelease: Attached script CharacterData.length is read without copying the text. Zero means source DOM is detached, not that all related allocations immediately returned to the OS.
metricDefinitions.bodyRestore: Synchronous fixed decoder interval after JSON.parse and before bootstrap validation/publication; overlaps the loader interval.
metricDefinitions.bodyHashVerification: All normal/free/all-answer strings plus sync flags, sorted by typed IDs and UTF8-encoded compact JSON, are hashed locally. Only record count and whole-dataset hash are exported; the operation itself is excluded from opening timing.
metricDefinitions.afterOperations: Forced-GC open heap/private commit after normal UI operations, with or without the separately identified full-dataset hash. Do not claim initial memory savings persist across large stringification or later workloads.
metricDefinitions.bootstrapBodyRestore: The synchronous product helper strictly validates metadata/references, reconstructs only omitted normal fields and removes the sidecar before existing bootstrap validation/cache/publication; included in the loader span.

canonicalComparison.scope: Non-eval JSON/Decimal parser restores the version1 sidecar, removes transport metadata and compares all11complete canonical fields; query.as_of is also actually equal here. Individual section/ID hashes are omitted. Canonical ASCII byte counts are not HTTP bytes.

wholeDatasetTextBaseline.scope: Whole-dataset normal/free/all-answer strings and sync flags, sorted by typed IDs and compact UTF8 JSON; only aggregate SHA256/counts are exported.

Full canonical print guard and sidecar rejection; existing search/color/latest/as_of/snapshot and authenticated-navigation contracts remain.

browserFullWorkflow.pcPrint: All4PC runs reject the full restored snapshot by32MiB; each1000target bounded print has1000rendered and pending0. The original30second placeholder-resource fallback is used.

scope.handler: Actual answer_map_handler await wall time; request construction and response-body materialization/transmission excluded.
scope.json: Original json_encode_for_html filter wall time and escaped output UTF-8 bytes, static section names in validated call order; a subset of renderMs, never add to renderMs.
scope.render: Empty-output functions immediately before/after production template nodes; includes JSON filters and template output construction, excludes mutex waiting and Tera setup before the first node.
scope.sql: SQLx QueryLogger elapsed_secs observations: statement setup/execution/fetch and potentially consumer/row decoding time; not database-only. Unlogged work may remain.
scope.unattributed: handlerMs minus summed observed SQL durations minus renderMs; includes Context conversion, body processing, scheduling, lock waits, unobserved setup/cleanup and instrumentation. Not strict pure CPU; overlapping observations may yield negative residuals.
scope.warmup: An existing preliminary load_answer_map call precedes one warmup handler call; measured calls are sequential on the same read-only pool and fixed query/as_of.

columnAndMedianConventions: A numeric array uses the named columns in this artifact; null means unavailable/not applicable, not zero.
timingMs/proxyMs values are milliseconds. CDP duration deltas are seconds, heap deltas bytes, LayoutCount/RecalcStyleCount counts.
heapDom uses bytes/counts. bootstrapDom/boundary textCodeUnits are logical UTF-16 code units, not allocated bytes.
Boundary iframePerformanceNowMs is local navigation-relative performance.now, not elapsed time from parent open.
Each speed/main-memory stage-mode median uses3trials; smoke and full-operation stage-mode entries contain1observation. Independent and nested interval medians must not be summed.
Private-commit delta from before-open is computed per trial before taking its median; DifferenceOfMedians fields explicitly subtract independent medians.
Functional operation times have no legacy full-workflow baseline and are not comparative performance claims.
bootstrapBodyRestore is the synchronous product decoder call, a subset of the full loader interval; it includes strict validation plus reconstruction and sidecar deletion.
MediansByMode for smoke/functional/operations-memory stages contain one observation per mode, not a repeated statistical measurement.
Native handler/SQLx/render timings are a separate warmup-plus3sample measurement per binary, not added to browser intervals.
Post-operation heap/private commit and initial-ready retained memory are distinct checkpoints. All-text hash verification is performed after full operations and outside the initial-ready timing.
limitations: Real performance uses a SQLite readonly copy; no real PostgreSQL DB speed or all-application performance is measured.
Mobile is390x844/CPU4x Chrome emulation, not physical-device RAM/GPU/battery behavior.
Only3samples per mode for speed and main memory comparisons; smoke/full-operation stages have1per mode. Differences may vary; no hard wall-time CI thresholds.
Sampling and performance.memory are observed maxima, not instantaneous peaks or full native/browser peak memory.

Windows private commit is resident-or-paged private committed allocation. WorkingSet sum can double-count shared pages and is not unique Chrome RSS. Node proxy/Rust/other apps are outside the Chrome PID sum.
Ordinary full MapView/auth is absent. Parent model retains only the selected19776records; isolated and inherited zoom16 scenes cannot be pooled.

Initial ready, loading cleared, frame settling and options completion are different milestones. Proxy buffering/HTML rewriting contributes diagnostic overhead and overlapping spans are not exclusive CPU breakdowns.
Full geometry/all bodies remain canonical after decode. Initial memory differences do not prove a lasting whole-session memory reduction; post-operation checkpoints are reported separately.

PC full print is normally rejected at the restored32MiB cap. A1000target print renders fully but placeholder resource loading exercises the existing30second fallback; this is not normal external resource completion timing.
The real fixture has no markers; marker codec correctness is covered by synthetic/backend tests, not a large real-marker performance run.

reproduction.before: Retain the pre-codec profiler binary, JSON loader and template; use the exact same readonly backup and private manifest/query. Explicit legacy-bootstrap points to that JSON loader, not an object-literal loader.
ordinaryOperations: same full workflow and memory flags
reproduction.safety: All private inputs/outputs stay under ignored target. No raw trace, body/ID list, coordinate, URL, individual PID or credential is included in this artifact.
